rows.definition: ContextOverflowError (internal/agent) is the client planner's terminal error for an upstream refusal saying the prompt does not fit the model's context: a 413, or a non-backpressure body matching IsContextOverflow's strict engine signatures (context_length_exceeded, exceed_context_size_error, maximum context length, prompt is too long). errors.Is matches ErrContextOverflow; the native loop records ended_by context_overflow.
rows.distinction: The CLIENT-side verdict on an outbound request, never retried or re-prompted because the same prompt can never fit. It is NOT InKernelContextLengthError (fak's own in-kernel admission refusal), NOT the upstream's per-slot n_ctx window, and NOT the context window concept itself.
